20853920_37bfbff7.text: CA2 pyramidal neurons are endowed with many unique physiological, molecular, and genetic characteristics that make them ideal candidates for assessing regional differences in molecular signals (Caruana et al., 2012).
20853920_37bfbff7.section: CA2 as a Distinct Glutamatergic Population

20853920_24f0ad48.text: The somata of neurons in CA2 are typically larger than those found in either CA3 or CA1, and pyramidal cells in CA2 fall into one of several distinct categories based on the unique branching patterns of their apical dendrites (Caruana et al., 2012).
20853920_24f0ad48.section: CA2 as a Distinct Glutamatergic Population

20853920_19e668eb.text: Schaffer collateral inputs to hippocampal area CA2 do not readily support canonical activity-dependent long-term potentiation (LTP)
